name: Ruxolitinib

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for higher risk of infection

fda.text: SERIOUS INFECTIONS, MORTALITY, MALIGNANCY, MAJOR ADVERSE CARDIOVASCULAR EVENTS, AND THROMBOSIS SERIOUS INFECTIONS Patients treated with oral Janus kinase inhibitors for inflammatory conditions are at risk for developing serious infections that may lead to hospitalization or death [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 )…

5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Serious Infections: Serious bacterial, mycobacterial, fungal and viral infections have occurred. Regularly monitor patients for infection and manage it promptly. ( 5.1 ) Non-melanoma Skin Cancers . Basal cell and squamous cell carcinoma have occurred. Perform periodic skin examinations…

summary: In the United States, Ruxolitinib carries a boxed warning, which is the strongest warning from the FDA, for a higher risk of serious infections that can lead to hospitalization or death [3]. Official warnings also note risks of non-melanoma skin cancers, heart events, blood clots, and death [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a medium score for liver risk and a low score for heart risk [M]. Additionally, one clinical study involving the drug was stopped because of safety concerns [5].
